dataset: 12 newly specified Python integer utilities; the same 12 specifications and grading grids in every arm
assignment: Six fixed task IDs are assigned a separate review session as an administrative condition; no classifier, labels or execution results used to dispatch. This flag is not a semantic difficulty score. In the RouteMode arm, dispatch to MAS if separate_session or parallel, otherwise SR. The pilot only exercises separate_session. Fixed arms ignore flags; report code correctness independently of satisfying the administrative preference.
order: One generation per task and arm. Stateful warm server, separate stateless requests; deterministic shuffled task order and cyclic permutation of condition order, seed 38521. All three named arms run afresh. No model session imported between arms.
warmup: Before study send an unrelated request and discard it. No cache flush between measured procedures.
metrics: A run passes if it satisfies output contract and every independent input/output case. Record wall seconds from before dispatch to after grading, locally reported prompt/output tokens and reference dollars (0.20/input Mtok, 1.20/output Mtok; no cache discount, equal rates across arms, no API invoice). All runs, including failures, enter averages.
interpretation: Descriptive pilot, one replicate, no stopping on results, no threshold tuning or superiority claim; paired wins/losses for labels. Connection errors are recorded and not silently counted as functional failures.
